unmapped_no_gl_number_rows.note: No GL account number visible in this workbook row. Balance is -1,905.56 in both May and June 2026 (zero delta), so it does not affect this test, but it carries a real nonzero balance and needs a real NetSuite acctnumber before the pipeline can key it generically -- a future month with a nonzero delta here would otherwise be silently dropped from Other Current Liabilities.

caveats: Account number 10104000 appears twice in Balance Sheet_2026 with conflicting labels: row 24 ('10104000 - Other Receivables', value-bearing -- $38,927.62 in both May and June 2026, mapped here to Accounts Receivable) and row 30 ('10104000 - Inventory Asset', a pure header row with no value of its own -- the real Inventory Asset leaves are 10104100 / 10104200 / 10104300). Only the value-bearing row was mapped, and this test ties to the cent using it, so it is not a live problem in this workbook. But if 10104000 is genuinely a posting GL account in live NetSuite for something other than 'Other Receivables' (e.g. if it is actually the real Inventory Asset parent account), a bs_by_account_month source keyed purely on acctnumber would collide with this mapping. Verify 10104000 against the live NetSuite chart of accounts before trusting this entry in a NetSuite-sourced pipeline.
